job.job_description:
Job Title: Software Engineer
Country: IN
City: Mumbai
Skill Category: ITTechnology
Role Responsibilities
Architect robust, secure, and maintainable solutions aligned with business and technical requirements
Carryout agile development on Python based applications.
Participate in POC to explore leverage AI/ML technology
Participate in code reviews, unit testing and contribute to the overall development process.
Mentor junior developers and provide technical guidance to the team on best practices and coding standards.
Troubleshoot production issues as needed, perform root cause analysis, and ensure timely resolution
Take ownership of end-to-end delivery, from solution design through implementation, testing, deployment, and support
Mandatory Skill Set
Proficiency in Python.
Relational databases
front-end technologies and UI development
containerization technologies
Desired Skill Set
AI /ML
Flask
Django
FastAPI
React
